description: Rename a symbol across the entire workspace via LSP and write the edits to disk. Use dry_run=true first to preview the changes without writing them (files, locations, and the edit). Call find_references before renaming exported symbols to understand blast radius. The result reports diagnostics for the renamed file after the edit; call get_diagnostics on other affected files to confirm no errors were introduced.

dry_run.description: If true\, return the edit as a preview without writing it

exclude_globs.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude from rename (e.g. vendor/**\, *_gen.go)

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source file

language_id.description: Language identifier (e.g. go\, typescript\, python). Optional; auto-detected from file extension

position_pattern.description: Alternative to line/column: use @@pattern@@ syntax to match text near the target position

name: rename_symbol
